stem: Which statement about oral manifestations in patients with special health care needs is best supported?

options.text: Enamel and dentin defects, missing teeth, and malocclusion make restorative care simpler than usual.
Medical management of a systemic condition never adds to a patient's oral health risks.
The cause, frequency, and severity of oral manifestations differ from one patient to another.
Attention-deficit and behavior disorders lower the risk of dental trauma and make home care easier.
Physical disabilities seldom interfere with oral hygiene or with caries and periodontal risk.
